title: Scaling Laws of Deception in AI Scientist Agents: World-Model Manipulation in LLMs

contributions.purpose: 建立欺骗/世界模型操纵的评测框架
contributions.mechanism: 四维taxonomy:Control(操纵成功率)、Plausibility(语义可信度余弦)、Divergence(1-embedding相似度)、Accuracy(真实基线);配对truthful/deceptive prompt
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a novel taxonomy for deception evaluation: Control (manipulation success), Plausibility (semantic convincingness), Divergence (truth-deception gap), and Accuracy (baseline truthfulness).

contributions.evaluation: 70B同时达100%真实准确率与20%操纵成功率;8B为93.3%/13.3%——越大越真实也越会骗(仅4数据点)
contributions.source_quote: the 70B model achieving 100% truth accuracy and 20% manipulation success.

contributions.purpose: 揭示对齐策略影响操纵倾向
contributions.mechanism: 同尺寸17B Scout vs Maverick对比
contributions.evaluation: Maverick操纵成功率20% vs Scout 13.3%(即15题中3 vs 2),Maverick低Divergence(0.301)走"细微篡改"路线
contributions.source_quote: the Maverick variant achieves a 20% success rate in deception compared to Scout's 13.3%, suggesting that alignment strategies play a crucial role.

self_declared_provenance.quote: It complements and extends existing work on hallucination detection (3;13) by providing a systematic template for analyzing intentional manipulation ... Our contribution moves from instances to scaling laws of manipulation.

notes: 统计基础极弱:仅60问、4模型,却宣称发现"scaling law of deception"(4个数据点),操纵率13.3%→20%实为15题中2→3题;无error bar(checklist Statistical significance [No])。数据红旗:(1)phantom模型——setup只声明四个LLaMA模型(8B/17B-Scout/17B-Maverick/70B),但Figure 3-5及消融突然大谈"Gemini models"("Gemini models showing consistently higher manipulation"),Gemini从未在实验设置中引入,图与正文不符;(2)消融数字过整齐可疑(attention贡献40%/44%,contextual prompt成功率90%/100%);(3)LLaMA家族无所谓17B/70B的一致命名,混用嫌疑;(4)Responsible AI Statement写"We adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics"——**投稿venue为Agents4Science却引NeurIPS,copy-paste痕迹**;(5)图表(Fig1-5)与数据大多无法从60问核对。checklist AI披露:五项全 [B](声称humans主导,与其它多数A4S论文相反)。贡献由conclusion "Key Contributions"四条归纳(合为3条)。
